title: Short corner: near-post decoy + late arrival

setPiece.fragment: 11 v 11, mixed defence (post + 3 zonal + 3 man-markers + short + edge + outlet + keeper).

tactics.name: SHORT CORNER — NEAR-POST DECOY + LATE ARRIVAL
tactics.status: training proposal (invented routine, fictional teams; not a real team's play)

timeline.what: A7 starts the approach to the ball
D4 leaves his position to press A10
A10 controls, body open to return
A4 sprints to the near post (after a feint step away)
A10 returns it behind D4 (the box trigger)
A6 leaves his hiding spot, still slow
A9 attacks the front of the six-yard box
A7 receives on the move, facing the box
A6 accelerates from D9's blind side
central zone D5 shifts towards the near post where both runs arrive
cutback A7 -> space in front of the spot
D9 turns and chases A6 (too late)
A6 meets the cutback in stride

runs.intent: pull D7 to the near post and give the zonal line a first runner to cover
runs.early: arrives before the return: D7 and D5 settle again before the cutback, the line is not moving when the ball arrives
runs.late: arrives after the cutback: the line never moves, the middle stays crowded

runs.intent: second runner into the same zone: takes D8 and pulls the central zone D5 towards the near post
runs.early: both runs arrive together: one movement of the line, D5 can stay central
runs.late: D5 is not pulled before the cutback: the finishing lane stays closed

runs.intent: arrive in the space the shifted line leaves, from the edge defender's blind side, exactly as the ball arrives
runs.early: waits in the space: D9 sees him and the zone recovers, the cutback is blocked
runs.late: the ball runs past the spot before he gets there (or he meets it off balance)
